section_name: Fixed Slope Intercept Adjustment and Mean Residual Calibration

candidates.title: Two Further Applications of a Model for Binary Regression
candidates.reason: Foundational paper introducing calibration regression to evaluate and adjust model predictions, demonstrating the estimation of an additive intercept under fixed predictor parameters.

candidates.title: Generalized Linear Models
candidates.reason: Establishes the mathematical formulation of generalized linear models with fixed predictor offsets, formalizing how an intercept is estimated conditional on fixed-slope predictors.

candidates.title: Regression, Prediction and Shrinkage
candidates.reason: Examines shrinkage and calibration adjustments in regression models, detailing how intercept recalibration corrects systematic baseline offsets while holding linear predictors fixed.

candidates.title: Validation Techniques for Logistic Regression Models
candidates.reason: Formulates calibration-in-the-large diagnostics and updates, showing how fitting an intercept with the predictor fixed as an offset corrects the mean residual shift.

candidates.title: Multivariable Prognostic Models: Issues in Developing Models, Evaluating Assumptions and Adequacy, and Measuring and Reducing Errors
candidates.reason: Discusses model calibration diagnostics and updating rules, highlighting the role of intercept correction to zero out the average residual error while preserving predictor slopes.

candidates.title: Probabilistic Outputs for Support Vector Machines and Comparisons to Regularized Likelihood Methods
candidates.reason: Presents post-hoc calibration over fixed uncalibrated predictors, optimizing additive bias/intercept parameters while holding underlying predictor outputs constant.

candidates.title: Greedy Function Approximation: A Gradient Boosting Machine
candidates.reason: Derives optimal additive constant initialization in stage-wise regression, proving that the optimal intercept under squared error loss is precisely the sample mean residual of the prior predictor.

candidates.title: Internal and External Validation of Predictive Models: A Review of Methods and Recommendations
candidates.reason: Categorizes model updating strategies and formally defines intercept-only updating (recalibration-in-the-large) using the fixed linear predictor as an offset.

candidates.title: Updating Methods Improved the Performance of a Clinical Prediction Model in New Patients
candidates.reason: Directly compares predictive model updating methods, showing that updating only the intercept with a fixed slope (offset) completely eliminates systematic baseline offsets.

candidates.title: Assessing the Performance of Prediction Models: A Framework for Traditional and Novel Measures
candidates.reason: Synthesizes calibration metrics, defining the calibration intercept estimated with fixed unit slope as the exact metric for overall mean residual bias.

candidates.title: A Calibration Hierarchy for Risk Models Was Defined: From Considering to Optimizing Alignment
candidates.reason: Defines mean calibration (Level 1 in the calibration hierarchy), achieved mathematically by adjusting an additive intercept to ensure average residuals equal zero while fixing predictor slopes.

candidates.title: On Calibration of Modern Neural Networks
candidates.reason: Analyzes post-processing calibration of fixed scoring functions, investigating linear transformations and bias/intercept shifts on top of frozen predictor outputs.

candidates.title: Calibration: The Achilles Heel of Predictive Analytics
candidates.reason: Provides a comprehensive tutorial on calibration-in-the-large and recalibration, explaining how adding the mean residual offset to a fixed predictor resolves systematic model under- or over-prediction.

candidates.title: External Validation of Clinical Prediction Models Using Big Datasets from Multiple Centres: A Tutorial and Guidance for Evaluating Calibration
candidates.reason: Provides statistical guidelines and model specifications for estimating calibration intercepts by treating the linear predictor as an offset, eliminating mean residual error in validation samples.
